decisions.reason: It clearly extends the firm's core cloud messaging capabilities and, with strong website prominence plus in-house R&D, management would expect to learn and improve rather than withdraw it.

Although document capture and recognition is a somewhat broader workflow step than pure messaging, it remains related to the firm's document-process offer and the firm's R&D base supports continued development.
Email and fax conversion fits the firm's established multichannel communication knowledge, so despite only modest website visibility it is close enough to the core business to retain.

As a close-in optimization feature for fax delivery, it is highly understandable and improvable within existing capabilities, though its lower standalone visibility makes it slightly more droppable than flagship services.
Email sandbox threat protection matches the firm's secure communications positioning and benefits directly from its related security expertise and ongoing R&D.
Multi-engine email virus scanning is close to the firm's established secure email services, giving management strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize it further.
